company.name: Creator Automation Platform
company.description: Empower creators with AI-driven automation tools to scale content production, manage social media, and build intelligent chatbots.
company.mission: Make professional-grade automation accessible to every creator.

basic.name: Basic Plan
basic.features: AI content generation, basic analytics, email support
basic.description: Perfect for creators just starting out with automation

pro.name: Pro Plan
pro.features: AI captions, advanced analytics, priority support, team collaboration
pro.description: For serious creators wanting maximum capabilities

enterprise.name: Enterprise Plan
enterprise.features: Custom integrations, dedicated account manager, white-label options, API access
enterprise.description: For agencies and large teams with special requirements

features.ai_content_generation: Automatically generate video scripts, captions, and thumbnails using advanced AI. Save hours on content planning and creation.
features.multi_platform_posting: Post to YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, and more simultaneously. Manage all platforms from one dashboard.
features.voice_ai_agent: Create voice-enabled AI agents that can handle customer calls, conduct interviews, and provide 24/7 support.
features.chat_ai_agent: Build intelligent chatbots that answer customer questions, capture leads, and handle support tickets automatically.
features.analytics_dashboard: Get detailed insights into your content performance with real-time metrics, audience analytics, and trend detection.
features.team_collaboration: Invite team members, assign tasks, review content, and collaborate in real-time on your projects.
features.scheduling: Plan and schedule posts weeks in advance. Optimize posting times based on when your audience is most active.
features.content_templates: Access thousands of pre-made templates to jumpstart your content creation process.
features.bulk_processing: Process multiple videos or posts in batch mode to save time on repetitive tasks.
features.api_access: Integrate our platform with your existing tools and workflows using our comprehensive REST API.

policies.refund: 30-day money-back guarantee. No questions asked if you're not satisfied with the platform.
policies.support: 24/7 email support on all plans. Pro and Enterprise plans include priority chat and phone support.
policies.data_security: We use enterprise-grade encryption and comply with GDPR, CCPA, and SOC 2 standards to protect your data.
policies.cancellation: Cancel anytime. Your data remains accessible for 30 days after cancellation.
policies.billing: Charged monthly. Discounts available for annual billing (save 20%). No hidden fees.

faq.get_started: Getting started is easy! Sign up for a free trial, connect your social media accounts, and start creating AI-powered content in minutes.
faq.free_trial: Yes! We offer a 14-day free trial with full access to all Pro features. No credit card required.
faq.integrations: We integrate with YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, Twitter, Twitch, and more. API access available for custom integrations.
faq.customer_support: Our support team is available 24/7 via email. Pro and Enterprise users also get priority chat and phone support.
faq.video_limits: Basic plan: 10 videos/month. Pro plan: Unlimited. All videos can be up to 1 hour long.
